subsystems.name: Offline fitting and held-out evaluation pipelines (E1 fitlib, E2 toolchain)
subsystems.evidence: Independent recomputation: Criteo full test (2,795,919) primary 0.11425529 = reported, constant baseline 0.2091478 = reported; session_rate deviance 3.30146 = reported from raw CSVs with own code; content_consumption rnd_test split rebuilt independently (89,752 rows, B0 0.4815997 = reported). Project reproducers give abs diff 0 for 8 more metrics. Prior-day-only features; user plus later-time holdouts; plan d6f4767 is an ancestor of fit d86f683 and its sha256 matches.
key_defects: no comparison against the simulator's existing rule-based behaviour (Part 5.3); baselines are constants and popularity only
selection ignores long-horizon stability and compute efficiency; the 4-day forward simulation shows the kept return_daily retention error 0.076 worse than both baselines (0.074, 0.072)
commercial model selected by outcome log loss, not uplift accuracy; worse uplift ranking than T-logistic (Qini 0.087 vs 0.089 visit, 0.159 vs 0.200 conversion)
E2 amendment 1 added the eventually-kept candidates after run-1 test metrics were seen (disclosed)
two duplicate toolchains and card schemas
subsystems.work_needed: Add rule-based-simulator baselines scored on the same held-out rows; add long-horizon stability (multi-week forward simulation) and cost to the selection rule; add uplift-targeted selection (Qini/AUUC) for intervention models; unify the toolchains.

subsystems.evidence: All 9 models load with SHA-256 verified (p3); F.6 tamper test passes; npz without pickle, each under 5 MB; portable predictions equal sklearn (unit tests pass); reproducers abs diff 0.

subsystems.name: Behavioural-domain coverage (Part 5.3)
subsystems.evidence: Registered domains: content_selection (KuaiRand random exposure, MIND), watch_duration, browsing_frequency (2 models), advertising_response (Criteo ITT), software_adoption (2 GH Archive short-horizon associations).
key_defects: attention allocation, repeat consumption (only a descriptive table, 145 repeat rows), purchase or price response, product retention or churn, community participation and social diffusion are not modelled
one platform per domain, 1 week to 1 month of data; RecSim NG unused; no sequence models
subsystems.work_needed: Fit and evaluate the missing prioritised behaviours on suitable public data (e.g. retention or churn datasets, community and diffusion datasets) under the same plan, holdout and baseline protocol.

subsystems.name: Commercial intervention-response model (Criteo randomized ITT)
subsystems.evidence: Recomputed on the full test split: ITT difference in means 0.01031 (se 0.00033), model-implied 0.00738, observed uplift increasing over predicted deciles 2-9 (top decile observed 0.058 vs predicted 0.066). The naive exposed-vs-unexposed contrast among the treated is 0.378, about 37x the ITT; the model and report never use exposure causally, only a labelled Wald estimate. Pooled-test composition bias diagnosed (stratified 0.0077, IPW 0.0075).
key_defects: simulator interface is a 64-type marginal table independent of ad content, price, relevance and frequency
negative predicted effects not confirmed (decile 0 predicted -0.0059, observed +0.0037)
unused by world code (see the integration subsystem)
subsystems.work_needed: Keep as the offline model; redesign the in-world mapping (see integration).

subsystems.name: Integration of fitted models into world participants (population, social, commerce, domains)
subsystems.evidence: p3/p8: in a population world run for one simulated day, all 9 population decisions are 'plausible, unvalidated'. calibration.load was called for content_consumption@1 and commercial_response@1, and both were silently discarded because their features are not in population FEATURES; browse_session@1, continue_watching@1, purchase@1 and churn@1 do not exist. Default social world: 0 load calls, feed calibrated = {}. p4: the 'learn' module (SlateClicks) is not registered by load_all_modules. p7: CalibratedOpen p_open is exactly invariant (max |dp| = 0.0) to uniformly better or worse affinity, and one viewer's probabilities change with other viewers in the batch. grep: no world code references commercial_response, watch_duration, return_daily, session_rate, content_consumption_feed or the software models.
key_defects: feature-name-equality plug-in that no registered model can satisfy, with silent fallback (models.py:146-158)
8 of 9 checkpoints never consumed by world code; news_click only behind an opt-in config set only in tests
batch-relative quantile mapping (consumption.py:179-187) erases absolute relevance and couples individuals
SlateClicks applies a news-click model to lesson search with a hand factor of 0.05 for irrelevant results; its module is not registered
the Criteo type table, if wired, gives content- and price-independent ad response
subsystems.work_needed: Write explicit per-model adapters from world state to each card's feature_map (fixed quantile maps fitted once on world reference distributions, not per batch), plug them into pop, feed, shorts/tube, commerce/ads and software adoption, and fail loudly when a configured model cannot be used. Enable them by default in Tier 2/3 worlds. Validate in-world aggregates against held-out data and in-world randomised experiments against the KuaiRand random-exposure and Criteo ITT estimates.

critical_findings: No population decision uses a fitted model: models.build loads content_consumption@1 and commercial_response@1, then silently discards them (feature names never match FEATURES); all 9 decisions run 'plausible, unvalidated' in an integrated run.

Only news_click@1 is reachable from world code, behind an opt-in feed config set only in tests; the 'learn' domain that uses it is not registered. Criteo, watch, return, session, feed and software models are never consumed.
FIDELITY_REGISTER rows 23-33 claim fitted in-world use 'via calibration.load' that does not happen; SP-5.4 fails (40 modules) and its parser drops 17 rows after a blank line.

CalibratedOpen quantile-maps affinity by rank within the session batch: p_open is exactly invariant to uniformly better content (max |dp| = 0) and depends on other viewers in the batch, a non-transferable simulator artifact.

Offline calibration is genuine: checksums match Zenodo, HF and GH Archive; I reproduced the Criteo full-test primary 0.114255 and session_rate deviance 3.3015 exactly; ITT (0.010) is correctly kept separate from the naive exposure contrast (0.378).

Protocol and licence: the E2 amendment added the eventually-kept candidates after test metrics were seen (disclosed; SP-5.5 passes); MIND came from an unofficial mirror that skips the licence gate; raw GitHub actor ids are kept.

skeptic.summary: 7 verdicts changed: S3 registry RETAIN->REPAIR, S5 commercial RETAIN->REDESIGN, S8 effort S->M with its 'measures correctly' claim overturned, F.1 RETAIN->REPAIR, F.2 RETAIN->REDESIGN, F.6 RETAIN->REPAIR, F.8 RETAIN->REPAIR. Upheld: S1, S2, S4, S6 (strengthened), S7, F.3, F.4, F.5, F.7, F.n1, SP-5.4, SP-5.5. criteria_weak set to true for F.3, F.5, F.6 and F.n1.

overturned.why: s1: editing the unhashed model_card.json (features order, feature_quantiles, prior_rate, selection.kept) changes predictions and in-world inputs while load succeeds, hash_mismatches=0 and qualifies=True; the F.6 tamper test only flips an npz byte (test_gate_F.py:170).
overturned.work_needed: Bring the card's behavioural fields under the hash (or move them into the npz) and pin card plus checkpoint hashes in an index outside the model directory; extend the tamper test to cards.

overturned.why: s3: respond(rng, types, treated) and sample_types(rng, n) take no individual state, ad content, relevance, price or frequency. The default table gives 18.4% of individuals a negative effect down to -2.6pp (honest table min -0.14pp), and the type-level slope is 0.84. transport scales the absolute ATE 15x (0.0025 to 0.039) with the base rate. Criteo sub-sampled the data so the incrementality level cannot be deduced. Offline estimator upheld.
overturned.work_needed: Design an in-world ad-response mechanism that ties response to observable individual state and to ad attributes (creative relevance through the content models, frequency and saturation, price), labels the absolute effect as non-empirical, validates transport against an independent randomised source, and makes the honest table the default.

overturned.target: Gate F / SP-5.5 audit and reproduction machinery (S8)
overturned.why: s2: with every E1 report rewritten so the kept model loses, calibration set to NaN and limits replaced by 200 'x' characters, plus a relabelled fake purchase model, all fast F criteria (F.1, F.3-F.6, F.8, F.n1) still pass and domains rise from 5 to 6. The slow F.3 checks only the kept model's primary metric.
overturned.work_needed: Recompute baseline and calibration metrics from data in the reproduction; require kept beats baseline in F.4; reject non-finite calibration values; cross-check reports against cards; run the reproduction in the official gate path.

overturned.why: No fitted domain drives any decision in an integrated world (r8 rerun: all 9 population decisions plausible; the default social world makes 0 loads). The fast metric also counts a relabelled model as a new domain (s2).
overturned.work_needed: Wire at least 3 domains into the default Tier 2 and Tier 3 worlds through validated adapters; change the criterion to count domains whose model drives recorded in-world decisions.

overturned.why: Commercial response needs a redesigned in-world interface and nothing calls it (s3). The randomised-exposure content model is never used, while the only reachable exposure-response model is observational news_click, whose card forbids causal use (limit 3).
overturned.work_needed: Integrate content_consumption (randomised exposure) as the exposure-response model for feed and short-video platforms and run in-world random-exposure validation against KuaiRand; redesign the ad interface as for S5.

overturned.why: s1: checkpoint_hash_mismatches==0 holds while card parameters that determine behaviour are altered. The expected hash sits in the card next to the file (self-referential).

The limits are documented but not enforced and are broken by world code: CalibratedOpen uses news_click as an exposure response (limit 3), SlateClicks uses it on lesson search (limit 2), and s8 shows it accepted on social posts (limit 1). s2 shows 200 characters of filler pass.
overturned.work_needed: Machine-readable allowed-use and population scopes per card, enforced at load or by the consumer, plus a negative test that a forbidden use raises.

upheld.note: MIND ungated mirror confirmed (datasets.py:144-190). Actor-id privacy severity lowered: extracted tables are outside the repo (/workspace/data/crucible/...) and never committed.

No feature leakage found in MIND popularity (hours < h) or KuaiRand PriorCounts. Added defect: selection ignores calibration (kept news_click ECE 0.0031 vs constant 0.00068; return_daily 0.0261 vs 0.0210). Equal-width ECE puts 86% of news_click rows in one bin.

Strengthened. s4: with matching names, the purchase decision returns 4n probabilities for n individuals and is labelled empirically fitted. s5: the calibrated open ignores follow, share, seen, familiarity, satisfaction and duration. s8: limits not enforced. test_v5_social_calibrated.py:49,68 would pass on the defect.
Rows 23/24/27/31/32 spot-checked; record_problems never checks that a claimed model is loaded.
Numbers reproduce, but the manifest criterion counts fabricated reports (s2); reproduction is slow-only and covers only the kept primary metric.
s2: 7 losing comparisons still count; test_F_4 never asserts on learned_models_beating_baseline.
s7 independently reproduces the ECE/Brier/coverage of 4 models exactly. NaN accepted (s2); no in-world calibration measured.
Licence route upheld; privacy severity lowered.
The 'not synthetic' status is a self-declared flag, linked to checkpoints only by card claims.
selection_check reads only cards; 'better' means the primary metric only.

additional_findings: The world can wire in only the observational news_click model (its card forbids causal use) as an exposure response, while the randomised-exposure KuaiRand model is never used.

CalibratedOpen reads no follow, share-arrival, already-seen, familiarity, satisfaction or duration state (s5): enabling calibration removes social diffusion and repeat avoidance from opening on that platform.
World-facing card parameters (feature_quantiles, prior_rate) are outside every integrity check (s1).
The fast Gate F suite passes on degraded or fabricated evidence (s2); unofficial Gate F passes are weak evidence.

The default ad-response table is the over-dispersed 'model' table (slope 0.84, 18% spurious negative responders). Criteo distorted the incrementality level, so in-world ad return on investment is set by transport and a hand-chosen base rate.
